name: Pauper
description: Constructed format where decks may only include cards printed at common rarity in a supported set. Typically 60-card minimum main decks with a 15-card sideboard; focuses on affordable, skill-intensive gameplay.
rules_summary: 60-card minimum; only commons (in supported printings); 15-card sideboard; format ban list may apply.
main_rules: Only common rarity cards allowed (supported printings)
Up to four copies of a card unless restricted
allowed_sets: Sets where a card was printed at common rarity
